status.pending: Each status.* key: an approval request's state, on a badge.
status.bypass: Approved by the Bypass policy, without asking the person.
status.auto: {{status}} is a status (status.*) an automatic review decided.
decided.auto: Each decided.* key: the line on an approval card once decided. "The socio" is the AI agent that asked; it carries on with its work after the decision. The _denied forms start with "Denied".
decided.waiting: The socio waits for the person's other decisions from the same turn; the count is how many.
decided.failed: {{detail}} is the reason, from the server, or decided.turn-failed.
decided.skipped: {{detail}} is why the socio didn't carry on, from the server, or decided.not-carried-on.
auto.badge: Auto review: a model that decides routine requests in the person's place. Badge on an automatic review.
auto.escalated: Before the review's reason: it sent the request to the person to decide.
auto.model: {{model}} is the model's name. The forms say which connection it ran on: the default one, or the person's own.
auto.model-time: The same, with how many seconds the review took.
auto.undone: {{outcome}} is what undoing did, from the server.
card.label: Accessible name of an approval request's card, and its heading while it loads.
card.asks: The card's heading: {{socio}} is the socio's name, {{capability}} what it asks to do (from the server, in English).
card.open-first: When long parameters must be opened on the card before it can be approved.
card.until: <expires/> is the date the request expires; keep the tag.
card.open: Link to the request's own page in Approvals.
bar.label: The bar over the chat's message box while a request waits.
bar.asks: {{socio}} is the socio's name, {{capability}} the action, in the infinitive, from the server in English ("create datasets").
bar.position: When several requests wait: this is the first of them.
bar.show: Button that scrolls to the request's card.
panel.title: Heading of the panel, on a socio's page, of its requests waiting for the person.
panel.now: How long ago a request was made, under a minute.
panel.minutes: How long ago, short, in minutes.
panel.hours: How long ago, short, in hours.
request.title: Title of a request's own page. "Socio" is a product noun: an AI agent.
request.description: <all> wraps a link to the Approvals page; keep the tags.
request.crumb-request: Last breadcrumb in the header, on a request's own page.
